text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Summer training camp to sharpen their skills has begun.
From day one, the sweltering heat was brutal,
leaving me worried about Orfevre's mood, but—

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...How naive.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Right? Cold-brewed black tea lets you
really savor the full flavor of the tea leaves.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Please, Trainer, you should try it too.
It really helps you feel the cool breeze.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: No, not at all.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"The intense heat seems like it will continue,
so please be sure to take breaks as needed, Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Please leave Orfevre to me in the meantime.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
For this summer training camp, Dream Journey
has agreed to join in as support.
An exceptional move for an Umamusume on the front lines...
choice_data_list: Are you keeping up with your own training?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your concern.
Of course, I plan to move forward together with Orfevre.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
However, I have no plans to race for a while, so...
right now, I hope to lend my strength to my little sister's dream.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...If Elder Sister is here,
then I have no use for you."

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Heh.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Don't rush.
It's unsightly.
choice_data_list: Oh, it was just a joke...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...You have an interview to attend after this, right?
Isn't it almost time?"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Come here, Or.
Let's fix your hair.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Indeed.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having become a Double Crown Umamusume, Orfevre was now
the center of immense attention.
The press's enthusiasm was palpable—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
—Please tell us your thoughts
on aiming for the Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
—When we interviewed the fans at the racetrack,
the anticipation for Orfevre was immense!
Please, could you share a message with them?!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: None.

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
I need no such enthusiasm.
All is destined...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
The promised day shall come.
For now, simply sit and wait.

text_block_list.name: Reporters
text_block_list.text: (Ooooooh...!)

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: That composure of hers is so cool...! I can't wait!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Before the Classic races began,
a gloomy air hung over everyone involved.
However, the atmosphere has suddenly become lively now."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, the interview came to an end...

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text: —I'll head back to the office right away and write this up into an article! We've gotta keep putting the word out and revving up the racing scene!

text_block_list.name: Reporter D
text_block_list.text: Indeed. Visitor numbers still seem to be down as well...

text_block_list.name: Reporter D
text_block_list.text: The mood of self-restraint continues, but... it would be nice if talking about her could serve as an opportunity to look forward, even just a little.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah.
